en zone.explanation: "En zone" means "a zone". It is the second part of "en fodgængerzone" (a pedestrian zone), built from "en fodgænger" (a pedestrian) and "zone". When you talk about public transport tickets, say: "Billetten gælder to zoner" (The ticket covers two zones).

en zoologisk have.explanation: "En zoologisk have" means "a zoo". It is built from "zoologisk" (zoological) and "en have" (a garden), so it is literally a zoological garden. When you say where you are going, use the short word "zoo": "Vi skal i zoo" (We are going to the zoo).
